messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m having the worst day. I’ve had THREE different debit cards decline on me today! The first was at a restaurant, the second at a gas station, and the third at a grocery store. They all showed “CODE 05” or “Do Not Honor.” Can you help me figure out what’s going on with all of them?

I’m sorry you’re dealing with that — I know how stressful it is when multiple cards decline. I can help. Quick overview and next steps:

What “CODE 05 / Do Not Honor” means
- CODE 05 is a generic/“catch‑all” decline that requires investigation. Common reasons include: card status (frozen, closed, pending), account-level restrictions, a fraud/security alert, or a temporary velocity/security block.

Things you can try right now (quick checks)
- Confirm these are Rho‑Bank debit cards (do they have the Rho logo?). If not, the decline could be from a different bank.
- Try a different register/terminal at the same store or a different merchant (some terminals are flagged).
- Try chip or contactless instead of swipe, or try signature vs PIN if the merchant allows.
- If one of the declines was at a gas station: remember gas stations often do a pre‑auth hold — that can make available balance look low.
- Check that the cards aren’t expired or visibly damaged.
- If you’ve recently used a lot of transactions in a short time, wait ~30 minutes and try again (velocity blocks can lift automatically).
- Use an alternate payment method meanwhile (another bank card, mobile wallet, cash).

If you want me to investigate from here
- I can look up your card/account records and check: card status (frozen/closed/pending), account status, fraud alerts, and any velocity blocks — and then tell you the exact reason or take the appropriate next step.
- To do that I’ll need to look up your account. That requires verifying 2 of these 4 items: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. If you’d like me to proceed, tell me which two you’re comfortable providing and confirm you want me to look up the account now.

If there’s a bank‑initiated security flag
- If I see a bank‑initiated fraud/security alert, I cannot clear it myself and I’ll transfer you to our security team for further review.

Tell me:
1) Are these Rho‑Bank cards?  
2) Do you want me to look them up now (I’ll need two of DOB / email / phone / address for verification)?  

If you prefer, I can just continue walking through troubleshooting steps without accessing your account.

Yes, they’re Rho debit cards.

Please look them up now. For verification, here are two items:
- Date of birth: 03/15/1990  
- Phone: 206-555-3842

Thanks — I can do that. I received the two verification items you provided (DOB 03/15/1990 and phone 206‑555‑3842). To look up your account I also need one of these so I can locate your record: your full name (as on the account), your user ID, or the email on file. Which of those can you share now?
Full name is Marcus Thompson. Email on file should be marcus.thompson@techdev.io.
